description: Returns the first three evenings after a new Moon with a crescent sighting verdict (likely, difficult or not visible) for each of 24 UK places, with sunset, moonset, Moon age, height and best viewing time. It covers the latest new Moon until its third evening is over, then the next one.

date.description: UK calendar date as YYYY-MM-DD, from 1900 to 2100, near a new Moon. The result is the window the website would show on that date. The current window without it.

name: check_crescent_visibility
title: New crescent Moon sighting
